criteria.text: Add additive `childCount:number` and `runningChildCount:number` to each history session/ancestor from direct children matching same scope/archive/project/owner filter. Replace existing childExists per-row query with one child stats query—no extra query count; hasChildren=childCount>0. Running means canonical presentation working state (verify statuses used; no guessing). Counts are direct children only; each nested parent gets its own direct total. Test exact0,38,60,164, archived/filter isolation, pagination, ancestors, SQLite query behavior. No DB migration.
Controller serializes fields unchanged; web gateway normalizes finite nonnegative integers and ignores malformed values safely. API/gateway backward compatible.

SessionRail label uses exact totals when provided, running exact total, regardless of loaded preview count. If old server lacks totals and session.hasChildren with incomplete/unloaded children, display honest `N+ subagents` (or `More subagents` before any loaded), never false exact. Loaded-child rendering/paging remains. Count updates from events/reconcile without collapse reset.

Replace separate bordered full-width disclosure row with compact inline disclosure attached to parent session row, no nested buttons/overlapping hit targets. Preferred structure: disclosure chevron is sibling button in same parent row; visible count/running sits in parent metadata or beside chevron. Session selection and overflow remain separate; 44px hit target can be visually quiet. No border/card/background; no extra vertical row. Child/nested rows depth/RTL intact; accessible name uses collision-proof shortest unique parent ID prefix already implemented; aria-controls/expanded if practical. Default/compact modes remain readable. Measure screenshot: parent with disclosure should not gain a second block row; no horizontal overflow at320/390; focus visible.

Expanding a parent with exact total greater loaded count supports existing child pagination; loading next page must not duplicate or falsify count. Preserve bounded reconcile flicker fix, explicit removal, project headings, search/archive/scopes/selected child. criteria.reason: The final run note records the old-live-API fallback limitation and rebuilt branch requirement.

criteria.text: Every SessionRail overflow/actions button (`.session-overflow-button`, data-testid `session-menu-<id>`) is a hit target of at least 44x44 CSS px in both layouts: the absolute plain-row variant and the static grid item inside `.session-row-wrap.has-subagents`. The target stays inside its row (no added vertical row space; row min-height unchanged), does not intersect the `.subagent-disclosure` control, and causes no horizontal overflow at 320/390. Icon may stay 15px; padding-based hit area is fine.
criteria.test: apps/web/tests/electron-e20-session-ordering.spec.ts — 'subagent-overflow-hit-area overflow actions keep 44px targets beside disclosures and on plain rows'

criteria.text: Keyboard focus never moves the SessionRail overflow/actions button out of its row. On a row without subagents (absolute variant) and on a `.session-row-wrap.has-subagents` grid row, tabbing to `session-menu-<id>` keeps its computed position, its offset inside the wrap, the wrap height and the `.session-list` scroll height unchanged, and the target at 44x44 or larger.
criteria.test: apps/web/tests/electron-e20-session-ordering.spec.ts — 'subagent-overflow-focus-stability keyboard focus keeps the actions button inside its own row'

criteria.text: The inline subagent count chip never clips its own visible label and never starves the session name: at 1280/390/320 the `.session-row` keeps more than 55% of the wrap width and the chip label's scrollWidth fits its clientWidth. Hover and selection paint the whole `.session-row-wrap.has-subagents` (background plus inset border on the wrap, no second surface on the inner row).
criteria.test: apps/web/tests/electron-e20-session-ordering.spec.ts — 'subagent-disclosure-density inline counts stay unclipped without starving session names'

criteria.text: Overflow/actions buttons and their menus carry unique accessible names when two sessions share a name: the shortest stable unique ID prefix used by the disclosure is reused for `<name> actions`, built over every eligible row rather than parents only, so no two destructive menus announce the same name.
criteria.test: apps/web/tests/electron-e20-session-ordering.spec.ts — 'subagent-disclosure-collision shared first-eight IDs use shortest stable unique prefixes while visible labels stay concise'

criteria.text: The inline `.subagent-disclosure` chip is itself a hit target of at least 44x44 CSS px no matter how short its label is (single-digit counts included), in the plain and nested `has-subagents` grid layouts, at 1280/390/320 and under a coarse pointer. It must not reintroduce horizontal overflow at 320/390 and must not intersect the `.session-overflow-button`. Root cause guarded: `.subagent-disclosure { min-width: 0 }` (specificity 0,1,0) outranked the coarse-pointer safety net `button { min-width: 44px }` (0,0,1), so the disclosure was the one rail control that opted out of the 44px contract; the E20 disclosure test now asserts width as well as height.
criteria.test: apps/web/tests/electron-e20-session-ordering.spec.ts — 'subagent-disclosure-repair distinguishes equal-count controls and indents nested controls without narrow overflow'
